component.name: Accordion
component.description: Coordinated disclosure list: single (one open) or multiple (any number open) mode, with an animated reveal.

anatomy.panel: content region (mounted always; inert + aria-hidden when closed)

layout.height: content-driven; panel height animates via grid-template-rows

variants.contained: bordered, rounded card group (1px var(--color-border), var(--radius-lg)) with hairline dividers between rows
variants.enclosed: same outer border and radius as contained but seamless inside — no dividers between rows
variants.divided: flush with hairline separators between items; no container border

behavior.interaction: Clicking a trigger toggles its panel. In type=single, opening one closes any other; in type=multiple, sections toggle independently.
behavior.defaultOpen: defaultOpenId / defaultOpenIds set the initially open section(s) on mount.
behavior.rendering: Panels stay mounted so aria-controls always resolves; closed panels are inert + aria-hidden and collapsed to 0 height.
behavior.animation: Icon rotates and panel height animates via grid-template-rows 0fr->1fr; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

states.disabled: per item via item.disabled; trigger is dimmed and inert

responsiveness.rules: Responsive by container width; text wraps; no fixed breakpoints.

usageNotes: Provide unique, stable item ids — they key open state and the trigger/region ARIA pairing.
Provide concise titles; content can be any React node.
Use type=multiple for side-by-side comparison; keep the default single for FAQs and settings.
